usage.send_request: Drop a JSON file into docs/agent-bridge/inbox/ (e.g. req_001.json) with fields: 'id', 'sender', 'title', 'content'
usage.read_response: Antigravity writes responses to docs/agent-bridge/outbox/ (e.g. res_001.json)
usage.safety_policy: Text-only exchange. Executable code or arbitrary command execution requests are strictly rejected.
